notes: World Bank's India programme: 75 active lending operations, $17.8 billion in commitments ($17.5B IBRD). Largest portfolios include Water (10 projects, $2.6B), Urban (11 projects, $2.55B), Agriculture (12 operations, $1.91B). 12-15 projects with $4.0-4.5 billion commitments expected in FY26. MIGA gross exposure $449.5M (Aug 2025); IFC exposure $10.3B (June 2025), record $5.4B new commitments in FY25. Page last updated Nov 10, 2025.
